scope: German second tier (2. Fußball-Bundesliga) from its creation in 1974-75 to 2025-26. 1974-75 to 1980-81 and 1991-92 were played in two groups (Nord/Süd, labelled North/South): one row per group via the tournament field. Earlier second-level competitions (Oberligen 1945-63, Regionalligen 1963-74) are not included. Title counts in the source list count each group win as a title
source: Wikipedia season articles (YYYY–YY 2. Bundesliga): league tables, points
https://de.wikipedia.org/wiki/2._Fußball-Bundesliga_YYYY/YY (German Wikipedia final tables: top three and points, every season and group; cross-check)
https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duit2champ.html (RSSSF champions every season and group; runners-up 1981-; third 1992-2008; cross-check)
https://www.rsssf.org/tablesd/duitYY.html / duitYYYY.html (RSSSF final tables 1996-97 to 2025-26; cross-check)

fieldNotes.footsimuId: ESPN team id (the id FootSimu uses)
fieldNotes.footsimuSlug: club page slug on footsimu.com, only for clubs in a FootSimu league in 2026-27
fieldNotes.footsimuPath: club page path under the league the club plays in now, without locale
fieldNotes.points: final points (2 per win until 1994-95, 3 from 1995-96); 1991-92 includes the carried-over first-phase points
fieldNotes.name: club name used in the source for that season
fieldNotes.currentName: club as known today (FootSimu name where available); defunct/renamed clubs annotated
fieldNotes.tournament: "North" / "South" (2. Bundesliga Nord / Süd) for 1974-75 to 1980-81 and 1991-92, otherwise null
fieldNotes.tiedWith: not used (ties on points were separated by goal difference; see notes)
